hero.title: Govera tsika yako. Dzidza kubva kune dzimwe dzose.
hero.lede: Nyora nemutauro wako. Verenga nyaya yemunhu wese nemutauro wako.
how.title: Kubva pazwi rako kuenda kunyika, pamitemo yako
how.s1: Nyora, rekodha kana kutora mufananidzo wechimwe chinhu chetsika yako, nemutauro wako.
how.s2: Wedzera kupi, rini uye kuti unoziva sei. Zvinyorwa zvinoita kuti nyaya ivimbike.
how.s3: Sarudza anoiona. Vaverengi vanoiverenga nemutauro wavo; yako yekutanga inosara.
cultures.title: Nyika imwe neimwe ine tsika dzakawanda
cultures.lede: Kadhi rimwe nerimwe igonhi. Vhura rimwe utaure zvaunoziva.
live.empty: Hapasati pava nenyaya yeruzhinji. Iva wekutanga kugovera.
langs.title: Nyora neyako. Verenga nechero upi.
langs.lede: Mitauro ine kadhoti ine mazwi akashandurwa nemuchina. Vatauri vanogona kubatsira kuagadzirisa.
collections.title: Zvinhu zveKasai
collections.lede: Zvinyorwa zvekureva zvemamyuziyamu, zvakasiyana nenyaya dzenharaunda.
rights.title: Kodzero dzako
rights.c2: Bvisa nyaya chero nguva. Makopi akatodhawunirodhwa haadzoserwe.
rights.c3: Mazwi ako anochengetwa sezvawakaanyora. Shanduro dzinoratidzwa.
footer.tagline: Nyaya dzinoramba dziri pasi pemutauri wadzo.
machine.notice: Mutauro uyu wakashandurwa nemuchina uye hausati wanyatsoongororwa nemutauri.
feed.composerPlaceholder: Govera chimwe chinhu kubva kutsika yako…

audience.membersDescription: Vanhu chete ndivo vakasaina kuStory Bridge
audience.privateDescription: Pachivande, hapana mumwe munhu anogona kuzviona
